transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Only text content blocks are accumulated per messageId. Non-text blocks add an empty string.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: Each agent_message_chunk emits conversation:assistant-message with final false and displayOnly false. user_message_chunk emits nothing because the prompt path already started the turn.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: After session/load, sealReplayedAssistant republishes the accumulated text with final true and confidence derived.
